SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Self- Improvement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Self- Improvement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Improvement.
   C. Say Self- Improvement never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Self- Improvement as rumours only.

2. Which statement about Self- Esteem Assessment is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Self- Esteem Assessment never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Self- Esteem Assessment as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Esteem Assessment.
   D. Explain Self- Esteem Assessment with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. Which statement about Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration.
   B. Treat Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration as rumours only.
   C. Say Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Name the president
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Measure rainfall only

5. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   B. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.

6. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Littering in markets

7. Which statement about Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ●.
   B. Explain Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● as rumours only.
   D. Say Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● never happens in Kenya.

8. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Ignore prices in shops

9. Which statement about Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain.
   C. Say Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain as rumours only.

10. Which statement about Vegetation in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Vegetation in Africa as rumours only.
   B. Explain Vegetation in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Vegetation in Africa.
   D. Say Vegetation in Africa never happens in Kenya.

11. Which statement about Scientific Theory about Human Origin is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Scientific Theory about Human Origin never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Scientific Theory about Human Origin with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Scientific Theory about Human Origin as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Scientific Theory about Human Origin.

12. Which statement about Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe.
   D. Treat Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Map Reading and Interpretation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Vegetation in Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
